title: Integration prior-art extract queue
description: The ONE intermediate index, written once at merge and FROZEN. Disk-authoritative: the coordinator spawns from it and never re-derives it, because a queue rewritten on a later wake spawns children against a moving denominator.

frozen_at.description: When the merge produced this queue. It is written once.

items.description: One admitted service, carrying EVERY param the extract spawn declares.

item_id.description: The canonical id. The record's filename derives from it.

title.description: The vendor's own name, so a reader can recognise the row without resolving it.

id_class.description: Declared, not re-parsed from the id, so the class is checkable independently.

location.description: Where the extractor starts: a resolvable URL.

found_by_angle.description: Which angles surfaced this service, COMMA-JOINED. Written by the coordinator at merge: it is the angle-granularity corroboration signal, and it travels serialized because every spawn param must be a string.

queue.description: The admitted services, in the ORDER they are to be walked. The order is part of the contract: rows are spawned in batches of `[cursor : cursor+30]`, so a reordered queue re-spawns work already done under a key that no longer matches the row it was created for.
